paper_title: Search-Based Interaction For Conversation Recommendation via Generative   Reward Model Based Simulated User
caption: The performance changes with respect to the depth of search. As a reference, we add the performance of ReFICR.
model_annotation:
Here's a structured description of the line plot, following the given guidelines:

The plot illustrates the performance of different models across varying search depths. The x-axis is labeled "Depth" and uses a linear scale, ranging from 1 to 5 with evenly spaced tick labels at integer values. The y-axis utilizes a dual scale, with the left y-axis labeled "Recall@50" and the right y-axis labeled "NDCG@50." The left y-axis has a linear scale, ranging from 0.3 to 0.7 with tick labels at increments of 0.1. The right y-axis also has a linear scale, ranging from 0.1 to 0.35 with tick labels in increments of 0.05. A green solid line with triangular markers represents "Recall@50 (Ours)," starting at 0.42 at depth 1 and increasing to 0.55 at depth 5. A blue solid line with square markers represents "NDCG@50 (Ours)," beginning at 0.23 at depth 1 and rising to 0.28 at depth 5. A dotted blue line with triangular markers indicates "Recall@50 (ReFICR)," remaining constant at 0.24 across all depths. A dotted green line with square markers represents "NDCG@50 (ReFICR)," holding steady at 0.15 throughout the plot.
